title: GridFall: AI mayors on GMI Cloud, built with Factory Droid

s1.description: Five AI mayors on GMI Cloud run one city, and how a single mayor turn works.

s2.description: The architecture: a seeded simulation, one network door and a first-person layer built from feature folders.

s3.description: How GridFall was built with agents: how the codebase grew, how a Droid mission is run, and how every change was verified.

s4.description: Shipping a 3D city to a browser tab: the web build and the lines that only appeared there.

s5.description: Lessons from sixteen days of building with agents, then the live demo.
